tools_used: WebFetch of a docketed supremecourt.gov PDF
helpful: the sal-v4 per-Term band table with the bracketed reached figure gave a directly scoreable anchor for the frozen baseline band
the full petition text made the jurisdictional and fair-presentation concessions visible rather than inferred
the snapshot's docket links let me retrieve the unprovisioned supplemental brief
gaps: documents.json provisioned only the petition and QP; the September 11 supplemental brief and the June 18 waiver were docketed but not fetched, and a waiver-of-response cut in the statpack would be the single most informative base-rate conditioning for a cell like this
no originating-court or lower-court-order-type filter on fedcourts query, so priors for state-court original-jurisdiction refusals cannot be pulled
the petition appendix (the order below) is not provisioned, so the judgment under review is characterized from the petition
notes: The WebFetch tool could not read the supplemental brief PDF's text but saved the binary; pypdf extraction on the saved file worked. A provisioning step that fetches supplemental briefs filed under Rule 15.8 would remove that detour.
